name: Liquid Healing
body:
Prerequisite(s): Drunken Demon

Benefit: By spending 1 point from his ki pool, you gain the ability to convert a single alcoholic drink that has been ingested into a potion of cure serious wounds. This is a standard action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity. For this feat to work, you must be under the effects of the feat, Drunken Demon. When you convert one drink of alcohol into one dose of the potion, your ability scores change (+2 to Intelligence and Wisdom, –2 to Strength or Constitution) as if the duration of the alcohol’s effect had expired. This ability can be used up to three times per day. As long as there is at least 2 points in his ki pool, you can make use of this feat.
